name: boost
description: Multi-agent reasoning and independent verification pipeline inspired by Google Antigravity /boost.
rules: Always create an ephemeral git worktree before modifying code for /boost tasks.
Spawn dedicated subagents for investigation, implementation, and test creation.
Do not mark tasks complete without physical execution of test suites (Exit 0).
Self-heal up to 5 iteration rounds when tests fail before reporting.

hooks.post_execution: bash scripts/boost-runner.sh verify $TASK_ID && bash scripts/boost-runner.sh reconcile $TASK_ID
